name: generated-visual-build
goal: Run generated visual verification against the stamped built app.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: The generated visual scenario declares build app but Playwright serves an unstamped development server and can reuse a foreign process.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: The existing app generator case checks screenshot paths but not built-server provenance. Strengthen that same case to require a stamp slot, setup, owned preview and normal E2E build order.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: The existing generator case failed on the missing build stamp slot before the product change.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Generate a build stamp slot and owned preview server; normal and Harness visual runs build and stamp before Playwright.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: The unchanged generator case passed at a5543047c3 after the test-only failure in the same environment.

steps.title: Reject the old unstamped visual setup using the existing generator case.
steps.evidence: Mutant e65d8f062a failed capture 0578fdd813e5; restored 109e9635fb passed b7dc581ff5e4 with the same tree as 057936fce5.

steps.title: Measure changed templates and retain their normal workloads.
steps.evidence: At 057936fce5, source bytes/lines/complexity/dependencies: project 8459/223/10/11, project tests 9315/218/12/5, guidance 18477/146/9/3. Capture 9aa6c9d691dd retains normal workloads and whole-worker RSS; modules emit no separate artifacts.

steps.title: Build and stamp a fresh generated app without starting a server.
steps.evidence: A fresh CLI app passed format, typecheck, lint, audit and build; verify stamp and identity agreed on 774fbcfd8eb73cf869414476fa81bbb7443b47d618cad565dbbebfb15d4536c6 across 33 files. No browser ran.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
